# ParticleColor

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct ParticleColor
```

The colors particles are given when they start (or end), sampled per particle. A color converts to a fixed one.

## Properties

### White

```csharp
public static ParticleColor White { get; }
```

Every particle is white.


Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

A random color between `from` and `to`, per particle. A value, so making one per burst allocates nothing.

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

### Palette

```csharp
public static ParticleColor Palette(params Color[] colors)
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

One of `colors`, picked at random per particle. Copies the colors, so make palettes once (in a theme), not per burst.
